# Biongevity

> AI-guided longevity and healthspan care by BioAro Inc. for adults about 40–65 and their families. Xevyo, the in-house AI, explains results and answers questions with citations to this site. Precision health and longevity medicine: specialty care (cardiology with onsite exercise stress echocardiography, heart failure, internal medicine, endocrinology, respiratory, geriatrics, nutrition, skin, pediatric rheumatology), precision programs (women's, men's, gut, dental, mental health), BioAro Labs testing (47 tests incl. whole genome sequencing, microbiome, hormones, inflammation, brain biomarkers) and BioAro Drugs AI-guided bioactive protocols. Clinics and offices in Calgary (Canada), Dubai (UAE) and Almelo (Netherlands).

Information on this site is educational and not a diagnosis. For emergencies call 911.

## Departments

- [Cardiology](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/cardiology/): Heart care with onsite exercise stress echo.
- [Heart Failure Clinic](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/heart-failure/): Steady, proactive care for every day.
- [Internal Medicine](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/internal-medicine/): Whole-person care for complex and chronic conditions.
- [Endocrinology](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/endocrinology/): Hormones and metabolism, expertly managed.
- [Respiratory Medicine](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/respiratory-medicine/): Sleep well. Breathe easy. Live better.
- [Geriatric Medicine](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/geriatric-medicine/): Independence, safety and quality of life.
- [Nutrition](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/nutrition/): Evidence-based eating, built around you.
- [Skin Health](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/skin-health/): Physician-managed skin, laser and wellness.
- [Pediatric Rheumatology](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/pediatric-rheumatology/): Joint and inflammatory care for young people.
- [Women's Health](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/womens-health/): Optimal health at every stage of life.
- [Men's Health](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/mens-health/): Peak health at every stage.
- [Gut Health & Gastroenterology](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/gut-health/): The foundation of overall wellness.
- [Dental](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/dental/): Oral health as part of whole health.
- [Mental Health](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/mental-health/): Lasting emotional wellbeing.

## Testing and protocols

- [BioAro Labs](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/bioaro-labs/): AI-connected lab tests — genome (30X/100X WGS, exome, pharmacogenomics), ageing, hormones, nutrition, vascular, brain, gut, skin, dental and vaginal microbiome; private health packages
- [BioAro Drugs](https://biongevity.com/precision-health/bioaro-drugs/): AI-guided bioactive protocols (LONgevity+ NAD+ booster, glutathione, creatine, omega), every ingredient and dose shown

## Clinics and programs

- [Longevity Journey](https://biongevity.com/clinic/journey/): biological age, genomics, microbiome and clinical assessments in one plan
- [Virtual Clinic](https://biongevity.com/clinic/virtual/): secure video visits and a remote blood-pressure program (home target 135/85, 7 days, morning and evening readings)
- [UAE Precision Clinic](https://biongevity.com/clinic/uae/): Dubai longevity assessments — VO2 max, spirometry, ankle-brachial index, grip, body composition, HRV, cognition
- [Shop](https://biongevity.com/shop/): longevity programs (Core, Precision, Elite), health packages and a matching quiz

## Platform, AI and B2B

- [Healthspan platform](https://biongevity.com/platform/): longevity digital twin (biological, physiological, functional, behavioural, clinical and trajectory states), domain scores with a transparent Healthspan Index, AI coach in English and Japanese, clinician and family views. Members sign in at https://app.biongevity.com
- [AI health tools](https://biongevity.com/tools/): lab-result explainer, visit-prep brief, specialist router (on-device matching; Xevyo on request; nothing stored)
- [BioELR](https://biongevity.com/bioelr/): longevity-focused health record system for clinics, resorts and communities — AI clinical support, voice notes, scheduling, billing, inventory, cardiac/derma/dental modules, HL7, SNOMED CT and ICD
- [How our AI works](https://biongevity.com/ai/): principles, evidence levels and model cards for Xevyo and on-device models
- [Site index for AI](https://biongevity.com/site-index.json): passages used to ground Xevyo answers
